US data centers (OpenStreetMap) overlaid on principal-aquifer polygons (USGS). Data centers use large volumes of water for cooling, so siting them over stressed groundwater is a growing concern. OSM data-center coverage is incomplete, and no open dataset of PROPOSED data centers exists (news/zoning only) - so this shows existing, mapped facilities only. Click a data center for its details, or an aquifer for its name.

About this data

US data centers (OpenStreetMap) overlaid on principal-aquifer polygons (USGS). Data centers use large volumes of water for cooling, so siting them over stressed groundwater is a growing concern. OSM data-center coverage is incomplete, and no open dataset of PROPOSED data centers exists (news/zoning only) - so this shows existing, mapped facilities only. Click a data center for its details, or an aquifer for its name.
